title: Summit and Wreck
author: Lior Eastwick
blurb: Rosalind Blackwood, a riverboat captain who knows every sandbar's mood, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. Then an expedition upriver stops answering the radio — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides before the monsoon makes landfall.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
